title: Non-Destructive Coconut Maturity Classification from Tapping Sounds Using Frozen CLAP Embeddings and Multi-Event Aggregation
relevance: CLOSEST WORK. Coconut tapping (public 3-class immature/mature/overmature dataset, 3 ridge positions): frozen CLAP embeddings + regularized MLP beat Mel-spectral controls by 8.89-10.18 pp (event) and 34.73-38.89 pp (fruit); fruit-disjoint partitioning; majority-vote aggregation over taps. No batch/season-disjoint test and no fine-tuning reported in the abstract; CLAP checkpoint not named in abstract. Full text blocked (publisher 403).

title: A Non-Destructive Acoustic Tapping System with Deep Learning for Pineapple Juiciness Classification in Postharvest Quality Assessment
relevance: Pineapple juiciness, 300 fruits, smartphone tapping: MFCC-based CNN (acc 0.9415) was more reliable than YAMNet and VGGish embeddings. Counter-evidence that generic pretrained embeddings do not automatically beat task-specific features. No cross-batch test stated.

title: Predicting Maturity of Coconut Fruit from Acoustic Signal with Applications of Deep Learning
venue: The 2nd International Online Conference on Agriculture
relevance: Coconut knocking (122 signals): ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50/InceptionV3/MobileNetV2 on spectrogram images. Vision-pretrained CNN on spectrograms, not an audio foundation encoder.

title: Nondestructive Maturity Measurement of Durian Using Acoustic Signal
venue: 2024 12th International Japan-Africa Conference on Electronics, Communications, and Computations (JAC-ECC)
relevance: Durian (Vietnamese 'Dona') knocking: STFT images + ImageNet MobileNetV2, 91.72% validation accuracy. Only durian knock work found with any pretrained encoder; ImageNet, not audio pretraining; no batch-disjoint test stated.

title: Determining Philippine coconut maturity level using machine learning algorithms based on acoustic signal
relevance: Philippine coconut maturity from acoustic signals with classical ML (COMPAG). Context for coconut acoustic datasets; whether it is the source of the dataset used by the CLAP study is NOT verified.

relevance: Hass avocado (146 fruit): image + acoustic impulse + weight fusion; IAWM 0.949, IAM 0.923, image-only 0.838 accuracy. Precedent for acoustic+image ripeness fusion; encoders and validation grouping not stated in abstract.

title: Integrating Acoustic and Image Data Features for Melon Ripeness Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network
venue: International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications
relevance: Melon ripeness (230 samples): image + MFCC multimodal CNN with augmentation (F1 0.94). Small-data fusion precedent; no pretrained audio encoder, no batch test stated.

title: Conventional MFCC and phase-difference MFCC interaction network for durian days-after-anthesis estimation
relevance: Orkweha 2026 COMPAG durian MFCC/phase-difference MFCC network (also in baseline memo). Content not verified.

venue: Journal of Food Composition and Analysis
relevance: Pear firmness from acoustic+vibration signals with dual-input CNN-Transformer vs MobileNet/ResNet/Transformer and PLS/SVR. Fruit acoustic deep model; no foundation encoder or batch test stated.

title: On the Cross-Container Recognition of Liquid Types From Pouring Sounds
relevance: Liquid type from pouring sounds, leave-one-container-out (LOCO) over 7 containers: train-on-one-container 59.27% on unseen containers, AST beat VGGish/ResNet-50; AST+multi-task 95.02% vs AST baseline 85.80% under LOCO. Closest methodological analogue of leave-one-group-out with a pretrained audio transformer.

title: General-Purpose Audio Foundation Models Improve Zero-Adaptation Cross-Water Transfer in Underwater Acoustic Target Recognition
relevance: PREPRINT. Six frozen audio FMs (wav2vec2-base/large, HuBERT-base, WavLM-base+, AST, CLAP-HTSAT) on 4 underwater corpora: within-corpus frozen probes trail a trained/fine-tuned ResNet-18 on macro-F1, but in cross-corpus zero-shot probe transfer the best frozen FM beat the trained ResNet-18 on 11/12 directions; environmental-audio pretraining (AST, CLAP) beat speech pretraining in 6/8 cells; wav2vec2-large never beat base. Strongest evidence that frozen FMs help mainly under cross-domain transfer.

title: Linear probing enables Ship-Radiated Noise recognition with pretrained audio embeddings
relevance: Ship-radiated noise: frozen pretrained audio embeddings; embedding geometry dominated by recording-specific characteristics, which a linear probe can suppress. Analogue of batch/recording effects in frozen embeddings.

title: Scoring Backends Matter More Than Pooling: A Systematic Study of Training-Free Anomalous Sound Detection under Domain Shift
relevance: PREPRINT. Frozen BEATs iter3+ (AS2M), DCASE2023 T2 machine sounds under source/target domain shift: switching scoring backend moved target-domain AUC by 13.8 points on average vs 3.2 for switching temporal pooling (mean/GeM/max). Supports fixing pooling a priori and pre-specifying the head; no fine-tuning arm.

title: Training-Free Model Selection and Domain-Aware Score Calibration for First-Shot Anomalous Sound Detection
relevance: PREPRINT. First-shot ASD over frozen audio embeddings with per-domain score calibration; source- and target-domain AUC negatively correlated across systems; dev-set performance does not predict eval-set performance. Warns against selecting encoders on in-domain results.

title: Improving Anomalous Sound Detection Via Low-Rank Adaptation Fine-Tuning of Pre-Trained Audio Models
relevance: ASD: fine-tuning pretrained audio models with SpecAug, LoRA vs full fine-tuning on DCASE2023 T2 (77.75% eval). Precedent for light (LoRA) fine-tuning of audio FMs under domain shift.

title: Dynamic Training Strategies for Domain Generalization in Self-Supervised Anomaly Sound Detection
venue: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech and Language Processing
relevance: Domain generalization for self-supervised ASD (DCASE2023/2024 T2). Context: domain shift is the central failure mode for machine-sound models.

title: Pseudolabel-Guided Disentangled Representation Learning for Cross-Domain Anomalous Sound Detection
relevance: Cross-domain ASD using a pretrained audio model for pseudo-labels plus disentanglement (Antarctic generator data). Context.

title: Hydraulic Seal Wear Classification by Fine-Tuning a Transformer-Based Audio Model Using Acoustic Emission
relevance: Hydraulic seal wear from acoustic emission: AST (ImageNet+AudioSet init) with selective layer-freezing configurations, 97.92% accuracy. Precedent for partial fine-tuning of AST on non-AudioSet transient signals; no group-disjoint shift test stated.

title: Reliability-aware transfer learning with BEATs for variable-length respiratory sound classification: a patient-disjoint evaluation in two public databases
relevance: BEATs for variable-length respiratory events, patient-disjoint: exact padding-support mask through fbank frames/patch tokens; full fine-tuning beat rank-8 LoRA by 3.94 pp (95% CI 2.54-5.40). Key precedent for BEATs on short padded events and for pre-specified fine-tuning.

title: On the choice of the optimal temporal support for audio classification with Pre-trained embeddings
relevance: Temporal support (input duration) for frozen embeddings: BYOL-A, PaSST, BEATs at 1/3/5/10 s; AST-type models (PaSST, BEATs) remain effective with smaller TS; shortest tested 1 s (far longer than a 150 ms knock); mean and attention pooling. No evidence below 1 s.

title: Unmute the Patch Tokens: Rethinking Probing in Multi-Label Audio Classification
relevance: Probing frozen audio SSL encoders (Audio-MAE, BEATs, ASiT, EAT, Dasheng, SSLAM): CLS/global pooling is a bottleneck; prototype probe over patch tokens +14.41 pp mAP over linear and reshuffles encoder rankings; closes 63% of the gap to fine-tuning on AS20k. Encoder ranking depends on the probe; fix probe a priori.

title: HEAR: Holistic Evaluation of Audio Representations
relevance: HEAR benchmark of general audio representations (frozen embeddings + shallow probe). Reference protocol for clip-level embedding evaluation.

title: The Efficacy of Self-Supervised Speech Models for Audio Representations
relevance: Speech SSL models (wav2vec2/HuBERT family) on HEAR non-speech tasks: strong on many but fail on fine-grained music tasks (pitch, onset). Caveat for using speech encoders on knock resonances.

title: Foundation models for bioacoustics – A comparative review
relevance: Review + benchmark of bioacoustic foundation models under linear and attentive probing (BEANS, BirdSet). Context on frozen-probe protocol choices.

title: Quantifying the reliability gap in cross-domain plant disease classification: benchmarking the limited efficacy of standard mitigation techniques under controlled-to-field shift
relevance: PlantVillage to PlantDoc: fine-tuned ResNet-50 lost 67.7 pp with confidence still 79.76%; adaptive BN/moment matching gave small gains, DANN degraded; in a frozen-backbone comparison DINOv2-S/14 had the best unknown-detection AUROC (0.764). Agricultural evidence of severe shift and limited mitigation.

title: Backbone diversity beats text supervision: a systematic study of frozen multi-foundation model fusion for in-the-wild plant disease recognition
relevance: Frozen multi-backbone fusion for in-the-wild plant disease: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 alone 77.56%; concatenating DINOv2+DINOv3+CLIP 80.23%; learned routing inessential. Supports frozen SSL+language-supervised backbone pairing and simple concatenation.

title: You Are What You Prompt: Prompt Quality, Domain Shift, and Uncertainty in Agrifood Vision-Language Models
relevance: PREPRINT. CLIP and SigLIP zero-shot in agrifood across ID and OOD datasets; prompt ensembling helps mainly under domain shift. Zero-shot use; not linear probing.

title: Single-Image Food Mass Estimators Do Not Transfer Their Gram Scale Across Datasets

Evidence that DINOv2 fine-tuning does not confer cross-camera transfer and that scale does not help.

title: Multibranch Ensemble Head in Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Cucumber Phenological Stage Classification
